title: AParadise Acquisition Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: AParadise Acquisition Corp. (ticker APADU), a Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing voluntary delisting from Nasdaq in connection with a business combination with Enhanced Ltd. Upon closing, the combined entity Enhanced Group Inc. is expected to list on NYSE under ticker ENHA around May 8, 2026.
key_points: AParadise Acquisition Corp. announced voluntary delisting from Nasdaq, effective on or about May 7, 2026 (last trading day)
The company is completing a business combination with Enhanced Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company
The combined entity, Enhanced Group Inc., expects to list Class A common stock on NYSE under ticker ENHA at market open on or about May 8, 2026
AParadise is an emerging growth company as defined under Rule 405 of the Securities Act
The company's headquarters is located in Hong Kong (Wan Chai district)
A registration statement on Form S-4 has been filed with the SEC containing proxy statement/prospectus
